title: Luhn checksum
prompt: The input is a list of decimal digits (each 0..9), most significant first; the last digit is the check digit. Apply the Luhn check: going from the rightmost digit to the left, keep the 1st, 3rd, 5th, ... digit as is and double the 2nd, 4th, 6th, ... digit, subtracting 9 from a doubled value greater than 9; sum all these values. Return true if the sum is divisible by 10. The empty list returns false.
